name: DhammaLab Brand Production Standard

voice.narration: one narrator for the whole video; quoted speech in the narrator's own voice; no character voices, no pitch lifts or timbre change; only weight, pace, pause, emphasis and warmth may vary

take_gates.words: transcript diff (flash + transcribe) incl. Pali terms

policy.profile: STYLE_CHANNEL only (STYLE / STYLE_SLOW / STYLE_STORY deprecated and blocked in code)
policy.rule: one narrator, one voice for the whole video; Jataka/character lines vary only emphasis, pause, warmth, firmness, slight pace
policy.target: calm adult storyteller, not voice actor; smoothness, comfort and continuity over drama

music.sources: YouTube Audio Library or another licensed source with verifiable terms; log every track in music_used.json and credit it in the description
music.style: ambient/sleep, no prominent melody, bass or percussion
music.bed_eq: highpass 70 Hz, lowshelf -4 dB @160 Hz, -4 dB @1.8 kHz, -2 dB @3.5 kHz

logo.asset: brand/official/dhammadeedee_logo_icon.png (official design 2, never redesigned; never logo.jpg 2019)
logo.position: top-right by default; top-left when the right side holds a Buddha, face, character or text

thumbnail.dna: gold/ivory + navy, 2-6 word headline, subtle official logo, mobile-first CTR

visual.standard: premium look, multiple scenes and motion that follow the content, gentle darkening in sleep sections
anti_sameness: every video gets its own scene set built from its own script; never reuse the hero stills or motion clips of the previous 3 videos
vary at least 3 of: setting/location, time of day, main subject, camera motion, colour grade within the brand palette, thumbnail layout
thumbnail layouts rotate (subject left/right/centre, headline top/side); keep only the brand DNA constant
record scene/thumbnail choices per video in asset_registry.json and check it before generating new art

qa: transcript per chunk (two models agree before a diff counts)
copyright / Content ID check in Studio before publish
human-ear spot check: start, middle, story change/relaxation, end
provenance manifest (sha256 of every source and the final)
make_policy: Normal production = 0 Make operations. Make only via pipeline/legacy with a manual make_guard rollback session (reason + max ops + expiry) and DHAMMALAB_MAKE_ROLLBACK=1; never automatic.
change_control: Production candidates are frozen: no re-render or asset swap without a real QC issue; this preset changes only by Nat's decision or when retention/comment data shows a problem
principle: quality baseline, not a visual template: brand identity fixed, creative direction per video

budget.rule: Experiment -> Measure -> Prove Value -> Increase Budget
budget.watch: video/motion is the main cost, not TTS: never auto-generate paid AI motion for every scene; paid motion only where it adds real value

tags: ธรรมะออนไลน์

secrets: runtime only: cloud-environment API credential (proxy) or env DHAMMALAB_GEMINI_API_KEY; never in chat/log/doc/code/Discord/repo

tool_choice.principle: best output quality for reasonable cost; score = quality x cost x scene importance x production speed

routing.google_flow: preferred creative video tool: hero cinematic / Buddhist cinematic scenes, image-to-video, frame-to-video, scene extension; hero image as first frame; fast/cheap model for iteration, high quality only for worthwhile hero scenes; extend only when needed
routing.gemini_video_api: batch automation, large volume, when API cost beats Flow and no interactive creative workflow is needed
routing.local_ffmpeg: slow push-in, pan, zoom, crossfade, brightness automation, simple parallax (free, default for supporting motion)
routing.canva_pro: graphic design, typography, thumbnails, simple motion, branded artwork
routing.chatgpt_image: hero visuals, premium Buddhist artwork, thumbnail artwork, scene concepts, when better than alternatives
routing.capcut_pro: Shorts production station only (not in long-form pipeline unless it clearly adds quality); spend credits on AI visual/video, smart captions, caption styling, motion text, subject/background processing, smart effects; never on trim/resize/fade/zoom/export

tool_choice.before_motion: compare Flow credits vs Gemini API cost vs local motion, pick best quality per cost

infrastructure_freeze.status: Infrastructure v1.1 frozen after secret migration + SYSTEM-SMOKE
infrastructure_freeze.rule: no refactor/optimisation for completeness; change only on a real production failure

long_form.pipeline: Research -> Script -> Gemini Voice -> Images -> Flow/API Hero Motion -> Local Visual Assembly -> Music -> QA -> YouTube
long_form.rule: premium key scenes + smart reuse/loop/crossfade/local motion; never low-effort or an obvious loop; hero motion beautiful, supporting motion soft

shorts.structure: Hook (0-2 s) -> Insight/Story -> Emotional payoff -> CTA to full video
rules: short-native, not a straight cut of the long-form
Related Video link to parent when suitable
shorts.role: discovery -> new audience -> funnel to long-form (not main revenue)

audio_structure.intro: music from 0:00 with a soft fade-in (~1 s); narration starts at 0.8-1.5 s (build_audio --lead 1.2); no dead air
audio_structure.during_narration: voice dominant, music 18-22 dB below (bed ~-36 LUFS stereo)
audio_structure.after_narration: pause 1.5-2.5 s after the last word, raised-cosine rise 10-20 s, +6..+10 dB over the bed, music-only target -23..-25 LUFS stereo (default -25), speech-band carve removed; tune by ear
audio_structure.outro_track: may crossfade to a dedicated fuller sleep track: no prominent percussion, no hits, no attention-grabbing melody
audio_structure.outro_length: by content: general Dhamma 1-3 min, bedtime 3-10 min, guided meditation longer; measure end retention
audio_structure.qc: pipeline/structure_qc.py: 0:00-0:10 dead air, 10 s before narration end, narration->music, +30 s, middle of music-only, last 30 s; loudness, smoothness, clicks, jumps, too quiet/loud; true peak <= -1.5 dBTP
audio_structure.retrofit: pipeline/audio_structure_fix.py applies this to an approved render locally (API cost 0)
